meta.title: Update Async Tests Under Dependencies Extension to Use the Modern AsyncQueue Pattern
meta.body_summary: Modernize 28 async unit tests in the dependencies extension from deprecated testCaseAsync pattern to modern asyncQueue pattern, claiming better performance and error handling.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot test modernization introduced pervasive TypeScript syntax errors; maintainer repeatedly pointed to specific line errors, but after many rounds the compilation never succeeded, leading to closure without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 4564 changed lines across 46 files, this is a large-scale refactor by absolute volume, driven mostly by a massive rewrite of ajax.tests.ts (2719 changes) plus a merge of upstream changes. As a test modernization performance PR it was closed—not merged—because Copilot could not produce a compiling test suite despite many rounds of targeted error fixes.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot's asyncQueue conversion introduced dozens of TypeScript syntax errors (missing parentheses, malformed async queue structures) that prevented the test file from compiling. Maintainer Karlie-777 iteratively provided specific error line numbers and structural feedback, but Copilot's fixes were incomplete and the file still contained 46+ errors at the last check.
review_details.performance_claim: Better performance through improved async task scheduling and enhanced error handling.
review_details.rejection_signals: Persistent compilation failures after multiple rounds of precise error feedback; no approval or merge. PR was eventually closed without an explicit rejection comment, but the outcome clearly indicates functional failure.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot struggled with a large-scale test refactor requiring precise syntactic transformations in TypeScript; it failed to resolve pervasive syntax errors even after multiple rounds of specific feedback, indicating a boundary in handling exhaustive, error‑sensitive codebase modifications.

detection_detail.code_reading: Karlie-777 reviewed error logs and provided exact line numbers for TypeScript errors; also gave high-level structural feedback on setup code placement.
detection_detail.ci_auto: TypeScript compilation via CI immediately revealed syntax errors on every push, driving the iterative fix cycle.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The PR body contains only narrative performance claims without benchmarks; the test file does not compile, making it impossible to reproduce any claimed improvements.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No merge occurred; the PR was closed after repeated failed attempts to fix compilation errors. No revert was needed as the changes were never merged.

core_change_summary.description: In ajax.tests.ts, all testCaseAsync calls were converted to the testCase + this._asyncQueue() pattern, replacing PollingAssert.createPollingAssert with asyncTaskPollingAssert, removing stepDelay/autoComplete/testDone, and adding .waitComplete() chains. A minor trailing newline change in InternalConstants.ts was later reverted.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most of the 46‑file churn came from a later merge of the main branch (commit 1bf9dd1), which pulled in unrelated changes across many packages; the core test refactor is confined to ajax.tests.ts.
change_trajectory: Converted first 5 testCaseAsync calls and gradually completed all 28 instances.
After initial push, maintainer reported failing tests; Copilot began fixing missing .waitComplete() calls and incorrect bracket syntax.
Karlie-777 requested that setup code be moved outside the first .add() call; Copilot applied this pattern iteratively across batches.
A series of commits (f022c13, 70fc84e, 11b91dc, e30fa76, 96c067b, b2b55b6e, 01fd5555, e7287008) were dedicated to fixing specific TypeScript syntax errors reported by line number.
Main branch merge (1bf9dd1) added large unrelated changes and introduced a new test case that Copilot claimed to integrate successfully.
Despite all fixes, the last comment from Copilot acknowledged 46+ remaining errors; no further commits followed.
